name: ollama-ai-provider-cgaspard
description: Patched fork of ollama-ai-provider-v2 bundled with Ollama Code (untagged file data + graded think + reasoning-before-text stream order).
_localPatches: dist-only (-cgaspard.2): OllamaStreamProcessor no longer opens the text stream on the empty-string `content` field that accompanies every thinking-phase chunk, and processes `thinking` before `content` within a chunk. Ollama chat chunks always carry content:"" while thinking streams, so the old `!= null` guard emitted text-start before reasoning-start and every UI downstream rendered the reasoning block below the answer.
